A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
slip nucleation in FeNiCoCrMo high entropy alloy is governed by the same mechanism as in conventional single crystals, i.e. the Peierls mechanism.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the CRSS in high entropy alloys is controlled by the Peierls stress, which is determined by the lattice resistance to slip, and is not affected by the entropy of mixing.
the slip nucleation in FeNiCoCr Mn high entropy alloy is governed by the same mechanism as in conventional single crystals.
slip nucleation is not a stochastic process, but rather is governed by the underlying atomic-scale mechanisms.
